name: Suntara Stones
summary: At the Suntara Stones, Dorius's letter tells of a team enslaved by the Dark Irons. The stones are real and held by the Dark Irons. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, uses the stones' power to enslave Dorius's excavation team. You carry the letter to his brother Thorius at Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

sections.title: The Dead Man's Letter
sections.body: Dorius's letter tells his brother he is gone if the message is being read. The Suntara Stones are real, and the Dark Irons hold them. Their leader, Lathoric the Black, uses their power to enslave Dorius's excavation team. The team was taken to the cauldron, where their minds are twisted as they toil day and night to finish something called Obsidion. Dorius begs his brother to help them. He calls it his final wish and asks that those who bring the letter be thanked.

sections.title: Thorius Hears the News
sections.body: Curator Thorius sobs when Dorius's letter arrives. Then he dries his face and swears by the Light that Dorius will have his wish.

faq.answer: Dorius wrote the singed letter to his brother, to be read after his death.
Curator Thorius resides in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

faq.q: What happened to Dorius's excavation team?
aliases: what happened to the dig team
faq.answer: The letter says Lathoric the Black and the Dark Irons use the stones' power to enslave Dorius's excavation team. They took the team to the cauldron.

faq.q: What is the enslaved team working on?
faq.answer: The letter says the team's minds are twisted as they toil day and night on something called Obsidion.
The letter names Lathoric the Black as the leader of the Dark Irons. They hold the Suntara Stones and use their power to enslave Dorius's team.

faq.q: How does this follow the earlier Suntara Stones?
faq.answer: The first Suntara Stones tells how Dorius was shot and the letter fell from him. You carry the letter to Ironforge.
